body:
Released: done-rules extension (§U item 4, row E).

Landed in 9bfe6fd2:
- Provider death is a state of the turn contract (DEGRADED_ANSWER), decided by classify_provider_death() and delivered by provider_death_answer(); the loop no longer carries its own booleans or wording for it.
- An unanswered call leaves a recorded unknown-outcome result (classify_unanswered_call + the pairing invariant at every iteration head), with a blind re-run forbidden for side-effecting tools; a raised call in a parallel batch no longer kills the sibling results.
- The parent completion floor spends the bounded replan budget (found by the live proof: 19 gate replans / 43 provider calls on one failed call, 9 after).

Verification: backend 3722 passed / 2 skipped incl. 22 new tests; tsc + eslint clean; live wire proof PASS (scripts/live_test_done_rules.py); the three prior live harnesses re-run PASS.
